item.title: Personal Portfolio Website
item.description:
A minimal, ultra-fast personal portfolio built with Hugo static site generator and the Cactus theme.

Key Features

  • Fast Performance: Blazing fast loading speeds with static HTML generation.
  • Minimal Design: Responsive layout optimized for all screen sizes.
  • Automated Deployment: Hosted for free on GitHub Pages using GitHub Actions.

Tech Stack

  • Hugo Extended
  • Dart Sass
  • Markdown
  • Source Code: GitHub Repository
